COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 3216 of 2018
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.

None appears for the petitioners.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for the
State.
Pursuant to an advertisem ent issued
by Director, Elem entary Education on
17.02.2016, petitioners applied and upon
their selection, they were appointed as
Assistant Teacher in different Governm ent
Prim ary Schools. According to them , as per
their option and also their ranking in the
select list, they were entitled to be posted in
District Udham Singh Nagar; but, they were
posted in other districts.
I n this writ petition, petitioners have
sought following relief:
"(i) A writ, order or direction in the nature
of mandam us commanding the
respondents to change the District Cadre
of posting of petitioners by transferring
them from their present place of posting
as Assistant Teacher Primary School to
any of the Primary School situated in the
District Udham Singh Nagar which was
opted by petitioners as their first choice
District for posting in their application for
the post of Assistant Teacher Primary
School."
A counter affidavit is filed on behalf of
respondent no. 3. I n paragraph no. 3 of the

counter affidavit, it is stated that score of
m arks of petitioners is less than the last
candidate, appointed in their category in
District Udham Singh Nagar. Thus, the
stand taken by petitioners that as per their
score of m arks, they were entitled to be
appointed in District Udham Singh Nagar is
belied.
No rejoinder affidavit has been filed in
rebuttal of the averm ents m ade in counter
affidavit, therefore, this Court has no other
option but to accept the statem ent m ade in
the counter affidavit.
I n such view of the m atter, this Court
does not find any reason to interfere in the
m atter.
Accordingly, writ petition is dism issed.
No order as to costs.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
